description: Counter-fixture for the vendored path exclusions. Three files sit one character away from an exempt path and must all keep counting toward the grade: a prop-fed <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML> at an ordinary component path (structurally identical to shadcn's ChartStyle — the case that proved per-rule suppression can't work), a `components/uikit/` directory that must not match `components/ui/`, and a file NAMED generated-* that must not match the `generated/` directory pattern. If the exclusion list is ever widened into a prefix or substring match, these fail.
